quote: Zid is a Saudi e-commerce platform for creating and running an online store. It covers the online store, point of sale (POS), payments, shipping, inventory, marketing and selling on marketplaces, all from one dashboard. Merchants can start on a free-forever plan and upgrade as they grow.

- [Themes](https://zid.sa/en/solutions/themes/): Store designs you can customize - [Mazeed marketplace](https://zid.sa/en/solutions/mazeed/): List products in front of 5 million customers - [Financing](https://zid.sa/en/solutions/financing/): Flexible funding for merchants

- [Marketing tools](https://zid.sa/en/solutions/marketing-tools/): Coupons, campaigns and customer engagement - [Sell on marketplaces](https://zid.sa/en/marketplace/): Amazon, Trendyol and Jahez from one dashboard
